en.t: Even Sakurako was like that, you know.

units.source_text: 尽管她很倔强，要么打男人的脸，要么又咬人家又顿足捶胸，

en.t: No matter how stubborn she was, whether she slapped men in the face, bit people, stamped her feet, or beat her breast,

units.source_text: 最后还不是落得同样的下场。

en.t: in the end she still came to the same fate.

units.source_text: 我们一开始就不是伊作的对手……”

en.t: From the very beginning, we were no match for Isaku..."

units.source_text: 阿光嘟嘟哝哝地说了许多话，

en.t: Aguang muttered on and said many things,

units.source_text: 她本想说些自我安慰的话，

en.t: meaning to say something to comfort herself,

units.source_text: 反而按捺不住自己害羞的心，

en.t: but instead she could not hold back her own embarrassment,

units.source_text: 像第一次在观众面前出现的小姑娘，

en.t: like a young girl appearing before an audience for the first time,

units.source_text: 为自己穿上崭新的、腰间和袖口缝上皱折的花花绿绿饰物的马服而感到羞愧一样。

en.t: ashamed of herself for wearing a brand-new riding costume with bright decorations and pleats sewn at the waist and cuffs.
